name: Human Respiratory System & Alveoli Cluster
semanticDescription: Anatomical human respiratory system model showing larynx, trachea with authentic C-shaped hyaline cartilaginous rings (open posteriorly), carina bifurcation, transparent lungs revealing internal lobar and segmental bronchial arborization, dome-shaped diaphragm, and magnified alveolar cluster with capillary gas exchange (CBSE Class 10 Biology Ch 5 Figure 5.9; CBSE Class 11 Biology Ch 17 Figure 17.1).
simplifications: Lung parenchyma modeled with optical dielectric transmission to reveal the interior bronchial tree arborization.
Bronchial branching visualized through primary, secondary lobar, and tertiary segmental bronchioles.

materials.look: Translucent vascular lung parenchyma with dielectric transmission and subsurface scattering
Hyaline cartilage C-rings open posteriorly with smooth trachealis muscle
Conducting airway tubules with lobar and segmental branching
Deep reddish-brown dome-shaped diaphragm muscle with central tendon
Microscopic alveolar sac cluster with oxy-red and deoxy-blue capillaries
